title: Speech Coach
lead: Tap Record. GifOS shows its own mic indicator and records up to 12 seconds; this app receives the finished clip, never a live microphone. Analysis stays on this device — nothing is sent anywhere. Pace is estimated from bursts of sound, not from a transcript: this app does not listen for words.
past.title: Earlier takes (scores only — the clip is not kept)
take.line: {pace} · {talk}% talking · {pauses, plural, one {# long pause} other {# long pauses}}
tip.short: That was very short — try a sentence or two so there is something to measure.
tip.silent: Almost no voice landed on the clip. Speak closer to the mic, or check GifOS still has the microphone allowed for this app.
tip.quiet: Lots of silence — fill it with confident delivery, or trim the dead air.
tip.pauses: Several long pauses — a few land, too many lose the room.
tip.volume: Volume swings a lot — even it out so every word lands.
tip.quick: You’re quick — slow down on key points to let them sink in.
tip.measured: Lovely measured pace — great for clarity.
tip.good: Well balanced — clear pace, steady volume, natural pauses.
card.title: Your delivery
fine.bursts: Bursts/min is counted from loud-vs-quiet, not words. This app never transcribes you.
delta.up: Versus your last take: talking up from {pct}%, pace was {pace}.
delta.down: Versus your last take: talking down from {pct}%, pace was {pace}.
err.noGifos: Open this inside GifOS to use the microphone. GifOS records behind its own indicator; this app never sees a live mic.
wait.recorder: GifOS is opening its recorder. Speak when the red indicator says it is capturing — tap Stop & use there when you are done (it also stops at 12 seconds).
wait.analysing: Analysing the clip on this device…
err.denied: The microphone was denied. Allow it when the browser asks, and leave it on in this app’s Abilities chip.
